options.description: The dot for the current page. Defaults to `●`, or `*` where `ascii` is on.
options.name: active

options.description: Draw with ASCII only. Defaults to what `unicodeSupported()` says of `env` and `platform`, since the default dots are not safe where box drawing is not.
options.name: ascii

options.description: The environment to read the terminal from. Defaults to `process.env`.
options.name: env

options.description: How the numeric form is written, given the page **counting from one** and how many there are. Defaults to `2/5`, which is not prose and so is not in the catalog; this is where `Page 2 of 5` in another language goes.
options.name: format

options.description: The dot for every other page. Defaults to `○`, or `.` where `ascii` is on.
options.name: inactive

options.description: The most pages that are drawn as dots. Defaults to 10.
options.name: maxDots

options.description: The platform to detect for. Defaults to `process.platform`.
options.name: platform

api.signature: function pageIndicator(page: number, pages: number, opts?: PageIndicatorOptions): string
